name: agent-graph-builder
description: Agent Graph Builder — visual graph authoring platform with playground UI and TypeScript SDK

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-playground run build
scripts.build:studio: pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-studio run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-playground run test
scripts.test:studio: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-studio run test
